name: Old Fort Furniture
old_description: "We Offer the Finest Handcrafted, American-Made Furniture with the Goal of Bringing High-End Quality & Comfort to the Arkansas River Valley Region & Beyond!"
about:
Old Fort Furniture operates from a showroom at 7606 Fort Chaffee Boulevard in Fort Smith, Arkansas. The business is veteran-owned and operated by Randy and Tina, who are identified as the owners in customer reviews. No founding year is disclosed in the available information.

The store specializes in American Heritage Style Furniture, carrying lines such as Ameritage Heritage Brands. It positions itself as a source for handcrafted, American-made furniture, offering pieces described as high-end quality and comfort. The showroom is open Monday through Saturday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., and the business provides delivery service for purchased items.

The retailer serves residential customers in the Arkansas River Valley region and beyond. Reviews indicate buyers purchase dining sets, tables, chairs, and other home furnishings for personal use, often noting the durability and uniqueness of the pieces compared to big-box alternatives.

The company emphasizes its veteran ownership and commitment to American-made products as distinguishing factors. Its stated goal is to bring high-end quality and comfort to the region with furniture that is built to last, backed by personal service from the owners.
